title: Opening, birth date and his father's name
summary: Date of the interview; Barnes says he will be 70 on the 18th of February. His father had the same name.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Mealy Bonds, 7th of February 1962. Can you remember your birth date, Mealy?
Yeah, I'll be at the rate of, I was going to say, 70 years old, only 18 of this month.
Yeah. I'll be 70 years old. This part is slowed up now since then. Well, in about three months, you can say. Because the rate of I was fast, and I think it was time to slow up.
What was your daddy's name, Mealy? Who? Your daddy. What was his name?
My daddy's M.E. was, same as my name.
